description: Read a paper ledger back: its open positions, cash and the last fills, newest first. Nothing is sent to an exchange. Three forms. With paper_id (the id a no-token paper fill on entry returned) and no token: that one guest ledger, returned as { paper_ledger: true, exchange, cash, positions: [{ symbol, qty, avg_price, mark, mark_side, quote_at, unrealised_pnl }], fills: [{ symbol, side, qty, price, notional, bid, ask, quote_at, at }], more_fills, orders, note }. orders lists the ledger's newest paper limit orders, any state: [{ order_id, symbol, side, qty, limit_price, state (open, filled or cancelled), at, closed_at }]. Before it answers, the read asks the current quote for each symbol with an open order and fills each open order that quote crosses, at its limit price. Each position is marked at the current quote on its symbol: mark is the bid for a long and the ask for a short (mark_side says which), quote_at is when the quote was read, and unrealised_pnl is (mark - avg_price) x qty. Up to 10 symbols are quoted per ledger, each waiting up to 3 seconds; a position with no quote has mark, quote_at and unrealised_pnl null and a mark_reason (cap when the ledger holds more symbols than that, otherwise the quote's code, such as quote_timeout). With your user's Autoview account token and no paper_id: the account's own paper ledgers, one per exchange, as { paper_ledger: true, ledgers: [{ exchange, cash, positions, fills, more_fills }], note }; ledgers is empty when the account has none yet. With the token and a paper_id: that guest ledger moves onto the account (first claim wins; the reply carries claimed:true on the call that moved it) and is returned in the account form, ledgers holding just that one; this is the only form that writes, and once moved the paper_id no longer works without the token. qty is signed (negative is short); positions that are flat are left out; cash is null until a starting balance is set; amounts are in the symbol's quote currency. more_fills is true when older fills exist beyond limit. A refusal returns { error, code }: paper_id_unknown (no guest ledger has that paper_id), paper_id_other_exchange (exchange names another venue than the ledger's), paper_ledger_needs_id (neither paper_id nor a token), invalid_token, paper_exchange_out_of_scope (the token is not scoped for that exchange), paper_ledger_unavailable (try again shortly), paper_rate_limited (the paper_id form with no token is limited to 60 per hour from each connection, counted together with paper_reset; wait until retry_at), paper_id_claimed (with a token: another account already took that paper_id's ledger), paper_id_not_merged (with a token: the account already has its own paper ledger on that exchange, so it is kept, the guest ledger is not merged, and nothing changed).

exchange.description: optional: with a token, read only the ledger on this exchange (e.g. GEMINI); with paper_id, it must match the ledger's exchange

limit.description: how many of the newest fills to return, 1 to 100; defaults to 20

paper_id.description: the paper_id a no-token paper fill on entry returned, 32 hex characters; with no token reads that guest ledger, with a token moves it onto the account and reads it

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured). With paper_id as well, it moves that guest ledger onto the account.

name: paper_ledger
